key_decisions.decision: Unfolds the difficult compressed middle clause without importing a bride simile from another witness.
Keeps the bereaved-bear image and the adviser’s claims about David’s tactics.
Clarifies the threatened casualties while retaining the imagined report as speech.
Retains the dew image and promised total killing, contrasting the first plan’s single target.
Keeps the extravagant ropes-and-pebble picture as Hushai’s rhetoric.
Retains the narrator’s assessment of good counsel and divine purpose distinctly from the characters’ verdict.
Keeps the enslaved woman’s essential role and the reason for the relay.
Retains her misleading answer and leaves the rare water expression modestly general.
States the death plainly without adding a motive beyond the narrative sequence or procedural detail.
Preserves pinned Ithra the Israelite and Nahash rather than harmonizing the parallel genealogy.
Preserves the repeated roasted item rather than silently deleting it.
Uses the probable dairy sense of the difficult herd product and retains all three needs.
